## Summary
Build a mastery timeline chart showing p_mastery progression over time per concept/system, plus a streak visualization showing consecutive daily practice streaks.

## User story
As a student, I want to see how my mastery has changed over time and my practice streak, so that I can track my learning progress and stay motivated.

## Why this matters
Timeline data provides the motivational feedback loop. Without it, students see only a static snapshot. Streak tracking is a proven engagement mechanic — losing a streak is a powerful retention driver.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] API route GET /api/mastery/[studentId]/history returns time-series p_mastery data
- [ ] History can be filtered by concept_id, usmle_system, or date range (query params)
- [ ] Timeline chart shows p_mastery over time with configurable granularity (day/week)
- [ ] Streak badge shows current consecutive practice days and longest streak
- [ ] API enforces RLS — students can only view their own history
- [ ] Empty state: shows encouraging message when no history exists yet
- [ ] Chart supports selecting a single concept or viewing aggregated system-level trend

## Canonical decisions in play
| Rule | What it means for this story |
|---|---|
| Atomic Design | MasteryTimeline is an organism, StreakBadge is a molecule (pure display, no hooks) |
| Data Layer | createServerClient() in API route for history queries |
| Data Layer | Row<'concept_mastery'> — never hand-write interfaces |
| RLS | student_id scoping enforced by RLS on concept_mastery |

## Schema changes
```sql
-- Mastery history table for time-series tracking
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.mastery_history (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  student_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.profiles(id),
  concept_id UUID NOT NULL,
  p_mastery DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
  review_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
  recorded_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_mastery_history_student_time
  ON public.mastery_history (student_id, recorded_at DESC);

ALTER TABLE public.mastery_history ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "Students can read own mastery history"
  ON public.mastery_history FOR SELECT
  USING (auth.uid() = student_id);

-- After adding: pnpm db:types to regenerate database.generated.ts
```

## API contract
```
GET /app/api/mastery/[studentId]/history?system=Cardiovascular&days=30
Headers: Authorization: Bearer [token]
Response 200: {
  data: {
    timeline: [
      { date: "2026-03-01", p_mastery: 0.35, review_count: 5 },
      { date: "2026-03-02", p_mastery: 0.42, review_count: 8 },
      ...
    ],
    streak: {
      current: 7,
      longest: 14,
      last_practice_date: "2026-04-01"
    }
  },
  error: null
}
Response 401: { data: null, error: { code: 'UNAUTHORIZED', message: 'Not authenticated' } }
```

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// features/mastery-tracking/hooks/useMasteryHistory.ts
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

export function useMasteryHistory(studentId: string, filters?: {
  system?: string;
  conceptId?: string;
  days?: number;
}) {
  const [data, setData] = useState<MasteryHistoryData | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    if (filters?.system) params.set('system', filters.system);
    if (filters?.conceptId) params.set('concept_id', filters.conceptId);
    if (filters?.days) params.set('days', String(filters.days));

    fetch(`/api/mastery/${studentId}/history?${params}`)
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(({ data }) => { setData(data); setLoading(false); });
  }, [studentId, filters?.system, filters?.conceptId, filters?.days]);

  return { data, loading };
}
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E08/E08-S03.api.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('GET /api/mastery/[studentId]/history returns 401 without auth', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.get('/api/mastery/test-id/history');
  expect(res.status()).toBe(401);
});

test('GET /api/mastery/[studentId]/history returns timeline data', async ({ request }) => {
  const { token } = await getTestToken(request, 'student');
  const res = await request.get('/api/mastery/self/history?days=30', {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }
  });
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200);
  const { data } = await res.json();
  expect(data.timeline).toBeDefined();
  expect(data.streak).toBeDefined();
  expect(data.streak.current).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
});

// tests/E08/E08-S03.ui.test.ts
test('Mastery timeline renders chart and streak badge', async ({ page }) => {
  await loginAsStudent(page);
  await page.goto('/mastery');
  await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="mastery-timeline"]')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.locator('[data-testid="streak-badge"]')).toBeVisible();
});
```
